context:
# Goal
Round 40 for lane kama: falsify and verify the frozen claims (C1 calibration 7→7 — r38-verifier-routed digest-citation corrections; C2 operability 8→8 — r38 wave-evidence completeness) and support the frontier step. Integration owner is the L1 (KamaR40). You produce findings and drafts only; you never edit lane or fleet files.
# Constraints
- Your tools start at the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin. Every Report: trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin — write your report at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kama-shokunin/<that path> (the parked lane worktree; it is the only writable lane path for seats).
- Lane evidence under test lives at /fast/scratch/hyaku/kama-r40 (a fresh clone of the lane remote, tip efe25f962a0b3a2b9b111c03bb5b5386c9548195). Read only.
- Frozen claim contract: /fast/scratch/hyaku/kama-r40/.ufo/waves/round-40/preregistration.json; counters tools/round40-calibration-audit.py and tools/round40-operability-audit.py; base controls .ufo/waves/round-40/controls/{c1-base,c2-base}.out.
- /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow (source repo), sibling lanes and the fleet repo are READ-ONLY. Never write, commit, fetch or push there; never run campaign tools; never edit MISSION.md/AXES.md/scripts/ or .ufo/state/.
- Never mutate lane jj state or lane Git index; no git/jj mutations (read-only git is fine). Any fixture repo: D=$(mktemp -d) && git -C "$D" init -q; every later git/jj call names -C "$D"; verify `git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals $D before the first commit.
- Pacman transactions are PAUSED host-wide: never run pacman. Tooling: you may install/upgrade tools that help, after reading /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md (official channels, update-safety gate; record tool/version/channel/reason in your report).
- Never message agent://all. Do not spawn subagents (leaf).
